definitions.explanation: Equipment or clothing used to protect oneself from rain, such as umbrellas, raincoats, and rain boots.

examples.japanese: {雨具|あまぐ}を{持|も}ってきてください。
{天気予報|てんきよほう}では{雨|あめ}なので、{雨具|あまぐ}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: The weather forecast says rain, so rain gear is necessary.

examples.japanese: {登山|とざん}に{行|い}くときは、{急|きゅう}な{天候|てんこう}の{変化|へんか}に{備|そな}えて{雨具|あまぐ}を{必|かなら}ず{用意|ようい}しましょう。
examples.english: When going mountain climbing, always prepare rain gear in case of sudden weather changes.

notes:
USAGE:
{雨具|あまぐ} is a collective term for all rain protection items including {傘|かさ} (umbrella), {合羽|かっぱ} (raincoat), and {長靴|ながぐつ} (rain boots). It is commonly seen in outdoor activity guides and weather-related notices.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雨具|あまぐ}を{持参|じさん}する (to bring rain gear)
- {雨具|あまぐ}を{用意|ようい}する (to prepare rain gear)
- {雨具|あまぐ}{必携|ひっけい} (rain gear required)
